qualification_rule: Qualified requires explicit execution authorization, exact asset-digest verification, every backend-neutral behavior passing with non-empty evidence, observed process/file/network/model-download effects, recorded MCP initialization instructions, and successful cleanup. It never establishes production readiness.
live_bob_rule: Every executed IBM Bob record, including blocked or incomplete trials, requires an interactive IDE or Shell mode, a recorded client version, explicit workspace trust, and live_bob_observed=true. The observation does not imply backend qualification. Shell non-interactive mode is excluded because its pre-approved tools conflict with this protocol's manual-approval safeguard.
evidence_boundary: This protocol validates a record. It does not authorize, install, download, configure, start, stop, or remove a backend or Bob client.
